summary: Eliminated 4 downstream sorry sites (Until/Since forward/backward quantifier parts) by introducing prior_exist_transfer_bidir and wiring it into the main theorems. Reduced PriorComposition.lean from 7 sorries to 3. Removed strong induction from Until/Since proofs to fix K-shadowing type mismatch. The remaining sorry (prior_exist_transfer_bidir body) is the core multi-variable zone-placement problem.

sorry_inventory.assumption: Assumes depth-0 n-var atom agreement implies depth-1 n-var biconditional evaluation
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Requires Prior-UZ/SZ for quantifier conditions at depth 0, but theorem does not take Prior hypotheses. Not on critical path if prior_exist_transfer_bidir is proved directly.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Either add Prior hypotheses to nf_eval_from_lower_agree, or fold into prior_exist_transfer_bidir

sorry_inventory.assumption: At n=0 (empty env), quantifier condition needs separate argument
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Not on critical path (downstream uses n>=2)

sorry_inventory.assumption: From depth-(d+1) 1-var agreements + order matching + Prior-UZ/SZ, transfer depth-d (r+1)-var existentials bidirectionally
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Core zone-placement problem. Inductive step needs: (1) 1-var extraction from 2-var cross_extend, (2) zone-order matching for witnesses relative to non-anchor env components. Both sub-problems are tractable but require Prior-UZ/SZ interval existence arguments.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Prove by Nat.rec on d. Step d+1: cross_extend from env component gives depth-(d+1) 2-var agreement, extract 1-var for z/z', weaken h_1var for env components. For zone-order: use Prior-UZ applied at lower boundary, Prior-SZ applied at upper boundary, show formula is satisfied in interval via cross_extend witnesses from both boundaries.

continuation_context.resume_from: 4 downstream sorries eliminated, prior_exist_transfer_bidir body remaining
key_decisions: Introduced prior_exist_transfer_bidir (bidirectional) because quantifier biconditional needs both M->N and N->M at depth d
Removed Nat.strong_induction_on from Until/Since to fix K-shadowing: moved env setup (h_1var_env, h_order_env) outside the strong induction body
Env setup uses set envM_xt / envN_xt with explicit Fin 2 → carrier type annotation to avoid dependent type issues with Fin.cons
